title: justfile missing musl cross-compile recipes
description: CLAUDE.md Quality Gates lists 'cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' and 'cargo build --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl' as required before pushing when touching cross-compile targets. However, justfile has no recipes for these builds. A solo maintainer will forget to run these conditional gates because: (1) 'just check' doesn't include them, (2) no recipe makes them easy to run, (3) the deployment target is static musl binary, so this is not optional. Fix: add recipes 'musl-x86' and 'musl-aarch64' to justfile, or add them to a conditional 'check' variant.
